title: Coalition (v0, demand-only)
description: An ephemeral grouping of demand-stance agents that pool into one joint offer when solo matching fails (docs/spec/01 §P1 + §P5). v0 hard-restricts stance to 'demand': provider-side coalitions are disabled by default (anti-cartel) and are a governance-gated exception not built in v0.

stance.description: v0 permits ONLY demand-side coalitions (§P1). This is a const, not an enum, so a supply coalition fails validation by construction.

formation_mode.description: v0 coalitions dissolve after one negotiation. Standing coalitions are out of v0 scope.

aggregation.description: How member constraints combine into one joint proposal (docs/technical-deep-dive/02 §4).

proposed_departure.description: Point of maximum overlap across members' time windows (computed, not negotiated).

compatibility_result.description: Whether members clear the category compatibility check (e.g. comfort prefs). Rejection reasons are NOT exposed to the rejected party (docs/design.md §6).
